short.q: Explain the false friends: (a) le stage (b) le car. [2]
short.model: (a) work experience or placement, not a stage. (b) a coach, not a car (voiture).

short.q: Reading: « Il y a trop de circulation. La mairie a créé des pistes cyclables. » What is the problem and what did the town hall do? [2]
short.model: The problem is too much traffic. The town hall created cycle lanes.

short.q: Give three things you do to protect the environment, in French. [3]
short.model: Je trie les déchets, j'éteins la lumière et je vais au collège à pied.
points: Any valid action, e.g. trier les déchets (1)
Second valid action, e.g. éteindre la lumière (1)
Third valid action, e.g. aller à pied (1)

short.q: Say in French: 'I am writing to apply for the job.' Which formal phrase would you use at the end of an email? [3]
short.model: Je vous écris pour poser ma candidature. End with Cordialement or Veuillez agréer mes salutations distinguées.
